blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Phoenix coach Charles Tiu lamented his team’s late swoon heading into the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals, where the Fuel Masters will face the NLEX Road Warriors. The Fuel Masters finished the group stage with a 5-5 record after dropping their last two games by blowout margins, including Friday’s 133-103 loss to the Rain or Shine Elasto Painters at Ynares Center here. Phoenix actually won four of its first five games in the season-ending conference before going on a u-turn. Compounding the woes was the absence of Jason Perkins, who has been dealing with an injured foot. “[Our struggles] actually started at […]...
